mapper.select: /** [sql-lotFault.xml] LotFaultMapper.getLotFault **/ SELECT MP02.MP02_CODE AS ST08_CODE , CM08.CM08_NAME AS ST08_NAME , MP02.MP02_LOT AS ST08_LOT , MP02.MP02_LOT_SEQ AS ST08_LOT_SEQ , CM08.CM08_GBN AS ST08_PGBN , MP02.MP02_PCB_QR AS ST08_QRCODE , CM08.CM08_ARRAY AS ST08_ARRAY FROM TB_MP_02 MP02 ,TB_CM_08 CM08 WHERE 1=1 AND MP02.MP02_COMPANY = CM08.CM08_COMPANY AND MP02.MP02_FACTORY = CM08.CM08_FACTORY AND MP02.MP02_CODE = CM08.CM08_CODE AND MP02.MP02_ARRAY = 1 AND MP02.MP02_COMPANY = #{st08Company} AND MP02.MP02_FACTORY = #{st08Factory} AND MP02.MP02_PCB_QR = #{st08Qrcode}

/** [sql-lotFault.xml] LotFaultMapper.getLotFault **/ SELECT CM08.CM08_CODE AS ST08_CODE , CM08.CM08_NAME AS ST08_NAME , MP02.MP02_LOT AS ST08_LOT , MP02.MP02_LOT_SEQ AS ST08_LOT_SEQ , CM08.CM08_GBN AS ST08_PGBN , CASE WHEN MP02.MP02_PCB_QR IS NULL THEN #{st08Qrcode} ELSE MP02.MP02_PCB_QR END AS ST08_QRCODE , CM08.CM08_ARRAY AS ST08_ARRAY FROM TB_CM_08 CM08 LEFT JOIN TB_MP_02 MP02 ON MP02.MP02_COMPANY = CM08.CM08_COMPANY AND MP02.MP02_FACTORY = CM08.CM08_FACTORY AND MP02.MP02_CODE = CM08.CM08_CODE AND MP02.MP02_PCB_QR = #{st08Qrcode} WHERE 1=1 AND CM08.CM08_COMPANY = #{st08Company} AND CM08.CM08_FACTORY = #{st08Factory} AND REPLACE(CM08.CM08_CODE,'-') = SUBSTR(#{st08Qrcode},1,10) AND ROWNUM = 1
